name: mediaforge
description: MediaForge — plataforma local de processamento, limpeza de metadados e versões editoriais de vídeos e imagens (FFmpeg/FFprobe).

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,cyan "npm run dev -w @mediaforge/server" "npm run dev -w @mediaforge/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @mediaforge/web && npm run build -w @mediaforge/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @mediaforge/shared && npm run typecheck -w @mediaforge/server && npm run typecheck -w @mediaforge/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @mediaforge/server && npm run test -w @mediaforge/web
